mapper.insert: INSERT INTO budget_expense_request (employee_id, org_unit_id, account_category, amount, reason, exception_reason, status, approval_document_id) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{orgUnitId}, #{accountCategory}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{exceptionReason}, #{status}, #{approvalDocumentId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_id, org_unit_id, account_category, amount, reason, exception_reason, status, approval_document_id, created_at FROM budget_expense_request WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
